title: Web/docs: show generated-voice provenance and document voice generation
description: Coordination for the web/docs session. Show a `generated` sample's generator (engine, voice, text) in the sample view, and add a docs page on generating voice lines with `apricity-analyze voice`.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Updated scope for the web session: a 'New voice line' dialog (curators) calling the `requestVoiceLine` mutation; Job rows for `kind === 'voice'` (queued, running, done, failed with error) alongside 'analyze'; and generated-sample provenance (text, voice, requester, CC0 credit). The data model and mutation come from apricitus-d13c16 / 47a67e.
